description: Calculate monthly National Insurance and health-insurance contributions for a self-employed person below retirement age, without a pension, from a monthly income figure. Returns amounts split at the reduced-rate ceiling. Approved tax years: 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026. When the monthly income is below the published minimum income for a self-employed person, says so and also returns the circular's minimum monthly advance and the amount at the minimum income — the floor is not applied automatically, because the circulars do not state who it applies to. Excludes income tax, actual monthly advances, the annual minimum/maximum reconciliation, and every other category (controlling shareholders, kibbutz members, soldiers, early pensioners). Not tax advice.

monthly_income.description: Monthly income from self-employment, for National Insurance purposes (one month; not an annual figure)

tax_year.description: Tax year of the rates. Approved tax years: 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026. A self-employed person below retirement age without a pension; other categories are refused. Any other year is refused.
